0022600117.text: The Detroit Pistons, 2-0 and first in the Central, visit the Philadelphia 76ers, who are also 2-0 and first in the Atlantic, in Detroit's third game of the season. Jalen Duren is out with a hamstring strain and Ausar Thompson is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision, while Philadelphia has Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), LeBron James (back) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain) listed as out. The Pistons won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season series, most recently 116-93 in Philadelphia on April 4, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
